gen-gf-wdxl-lubrifont-jp-n-fs-literata: Sturdy thin lines and slightly heavier strokes give the body a bookish hush under the wire-bent, tightly stacked WDXL Lubrifont JP N. Literata, a classic serif whose modulation shows mainly up close, settles in beneath it.
gen-gf-wdxl-lubrifont-sc-fs-literata: WDXL Lubrifont SC packs clean, neutral letters tight as pins in a cushion. Literata, a classic serif drawn like a steady lettering pen, supplies the modulation that makes the pairing memorable.
gen-gf-wdxl-lubrifont-tc-fs-literata: Clean, snug letters with strokes that hold their thickness around every curve make up WDXL Lubrifont TC. Literata, a serif with sturdy thin lines and open curves, gives paragraphs a bookish, sophisticated pace.
gen-gf-wittgenstein-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans keeps generous space between its curve ends and stems, sharp and refined. Wittgenstein handles the drama, heavy verticals joined by hairlines, while the body type simply stays low-key.
gen-gf-wix-madefor-display-fs-literata: Wix Madefor Display is low-contrast and contemporary, with an unclenched c. Literata, a serif with moderate variation in line thickness, does the bookish, sophisticated work while the heading stays plain-spoken.
gen-gf-wix-madefor-text-fs-literata: Wix Madefor Text feels clean and approachable, every bowl left open, with low variation in line thickness. Literata, a classic serif, thins its joins gently without turning spindly.
gen-gf-xanh-mono-fs-bespoke-sans: Xanh Mono is precise and typewriter-like, with terminals that flare outward. Its thin strokes stay sturdy and its thick ones restrained, which suits headings, while Bespoke Sans gives text generous space around its curves.
gen-gf-xanh-mono-fs-literata: Literata is a serif of sturdy thin lines and slightly heavier thick ones, with wide, unclosed curves. Literata sits happily under Xanh Mono, whose precise, flared letters earn their keep big and short.
gen-gf-yanone-kaffeesatz-fs-literata: Approachable and clean, Yanone Kaffeesatz presses its glyphs together like type in a letterpress forme. And Literata, a classic serif with sturdy thin lines, adds a bookish sophistication that the compact heading lacks.
gen-gf-yrsa-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans is a sharp, refined sans with generous space between curve ends and stems, and little stroke contrast. Yrsa carries the dignified, traditional voice while the body stays quietly precise.
